_units: cm, degrees, servo speed/accel as Station takes them. Poses are taught (leader arm or by hand), stored as motor steps 1-8.

poses._help: Taught pose: x, y, z (m), roll, pitch, yaw (rad), steps (motor 1-8). Written by agent/teach.py, never typed by hand.

grasp._help: Gripper opening 0..1 as the IK API reports it. After closing, an opening above empty_below means something is held (jaws stalled on the pack).

measured._help: Fill from real runs: picks tried, held, placed, seconds per pick.

safety._help: Refuse a move if the IK solution differs from the taught motor steps by more than this on any joint (a flipped elbow).

sequences._help: Step order, played by agent/real.py. Steps: home, slot.<pose>, bin.<pose>, open, close, photo, wait:<seconds>. Any <pose> name you use here becomes a pose to teach (agent/teach.py slot1 <pose>). Moves after close and before open run at the loaded speed.
